name: Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset
description: The Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention dataset contains feature vectors of 12,330 online shopping sessions (10,422 negative, 1,908 positive) collected over a 1-year period to avoid campaign bias. It includes 10 numerical and 8 categorical attributes describing administrative, informational, product-related page metrics, bounce rates, exit rates, page values, visitor types, and special days.
